facts.business: Murudeshwar Ceramics Ltd. manufactures ceramic tiles.
key_risks: Inventory valuation risk due to significant inventory balance (18.61% of total assets) requiring management judgment on net realizable value
Property, Plant and Equipment capitalization risk from inappropriate timing or classification of project capitalization affecting depreciation and results
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include associates (RNS Infrastructure Ltd, Murudeshwar Power Corp. Pvt. Ltd, Naveen Hotels Pvt. Ltd, RNS Motors Pvt. Ltd, RNS Power Ltd, R N Shetty Trust, R N S Trust), KMPs (Satish R Shetty, Sunil R Shetty, Naveen R Shetty, Karan S Shetty), and their relatives. Transactions during FY2025-26 include purchase of goods (Rs 815.96 lakh), sale of goods (Rs 120.67 lakh), rendering of services to RNS Infrastructure Ltd (Rs 6,585.40 lakh), commission (Rs 522.00 lakh), receiving of services (Rs 17.72 lakh), and dividend received (Rs 67.02 lakh). Outstanding balances: trade receivables Rs 3,725.92 lakh, trade payables Rs 12.54 lakh.
